known_limitations.detail: The dashboard shows the committed STEP-22, STEP-23 and BMad reports as of the evidence baseline commit. It does not run the harness or CI. New results appear only after they are committed and `npm run evidence` is re-run.

known_limitations.limitation: No COBOL or generated Java content
known_limitations.detail: The restricted COBOL checkout (references/) and the generated Java (forward/generated/) are not committed, so the dashboard shows their paths, hashes and IDs but not their text.

known_limitations.limitation: Repository links resolve only for pushed commits
known_limitations.detail: Source links open the file on GitHub at the evidence baseline commit recorded in the manifest (the checkout's HEAD when `npm run evidence` ran). They resolve once that commit is pushed.

known_limitations.limitation: Dependency graph is explored by neighbourhood
known_limitations.detail: The 705-node graph is never drawn whole. Views are capped at 120 nodes by default (250 selectable), and shared prerequisites are not expanded unless focused or the expansion toggle is on. Truncation is always stated.

known_limitations.limitation: Mermaid rendering verified in a real browser for sample diagrams
known_limitations.detail: Rendering under the production CSP was verified in headless Edge for FLOW-PORTREAD (smoke test) and FLOW-BCHCTL00 (screenshot). All 65 committed sources take the same code path and are hash-verified; not every diagram was rendered in a browser. A source that Mermaid cannot render is shown as text with the error.

known_limitations.limitation: Accessibility verified structurally, not by an automated audit tool
known_limitations.detail: Landmarks, labels, keyboard operation, table captions, chart table views and non-colour status encoding are covered by tests and design. No axe or WCAG audit tool was run, and no screen-reader session was recorded.

The fixed status palette does not pass categorical colour-vision gates on its own (warning vs serious). Every status therefore also carries an icon and text, and every chart has value labels and a table view.
The built dashboard fetches its evidence files, so it must be served (npm run preview or any static server), not opened as a file:// page.
The BMad disclosure request expiry is the recorded value; the page also compares it with the viewer's clock and labels that comparison as such.

known_limitations.limitation: Backup tool does not exclude the dashboard's ignored folders
known_limitations.detail: forward/tools/backup.js excludes forward/node_modules, forward/dist and forward/runs, but not forward/dashboard/node_modules, forward/dashboard/dist or forward/dashboard/public/evidence. A backup taken with those present would archive them (dependencies, build output and evidence copies, all reproducible). Tests are unaffected (412/412 with them present). backup.js was not changed in STEP-24.

engineering_limitations_shown_by_the_das: legacy runtime equivalence unavailable (no COBOL compiler or captured legacy runs)
missing source members, paragraphs and copybooks; POSUPDT empty source
external platform services and legacy environment definitions
BMad authorization and live execution prerequisites
unverified data layouts and runtime semantics
